description: PAID $0.02 USDC. Whale transfers (>= $100k) on ethereum, base, arbitrum, polygon, solana classified by exchange wallet labels: EXCHANGE_INFLOW_BEARISH, WHALE_ACCUMULATION_BULLISH, INTERNAL_EXCHANGE_SHUFFLE, UNLABELED, with per-token inflow/outflow/net USD and signal, plus Hyperliquid whale perp taker flow. Returns JSON whale-to-exchange transfers with a signal label and per-token inflow, outflow, and net USD, plus Hyperliquid whale perp flow.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Chain to scan. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: all. Allowed values: all, ethereum, base, arbitrum, polygon, solana, hyperliquid.

limit.description: Maximum transfers. Format: positive integer. Example: 50. Omit for the server's current cap.

token.description: Optional token symbol. Format: a ticker. Example: USDC. Omit for every token.

window.description: Look-back window. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: 24h. Allowed values: 1h, 24h, 7d.

name: whale_netflow
